result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site, deliverables, work product, Content and relevant customer/transaction data; HDI makes a present assignment; HDI retains its pre-existing technology and know-how while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded materials; and joint ownership is disclaimed. The addition is targeted and leaves the existing operational provisions substantively unchanged. Minor drafting limitations are that the pre-existing-IP carveout and licence cover enumerated HDI materials rather than expressly all HDI IP, and Company Data is limited to specified data generated through the Site.
